Rocco, a sharp-witted African grey parrot, made headlines after his owner caught him asking Alexa to order treats and toys while he was home alone.

Rocco lives in the UK with Marion Wischnewski. Having picked up the habit from those around him, he learned to talk to the smart assistant. He added strawberries, broccoli, ice cream and toys to shopping lists—and even tried to place the orders.

When odd items began appearing in her Amazon cart, Marion investigated. The culprit turned out to be Rocco: whenever he was left alone, he’d been chatting with Alexa.

Rescued by the National Animal Welfare Trust, Rocco has won hearts around the world with his mischievous antics—and shown just how intelligent African grey parrots can be.
